description: Do the arithmetic on a set of collected answers: enquiries per person, the share that become leads, how many channels arrive without one record, and which of the eight are still blank. Every assumption it had to make is printed beside the result. It stops short of saying what to automate — that is the audit, and it needs an account. Runs locally, no account needed.

answers.description: What you have collected, keyed by field: {"industry": "…", "dailyInquiries": "50-100", …}. Use "__skip__" for a question that was declined — it is a better answer than a guess.

name: read_answers
